str.plain: Hitting hard and lifting heavy things

dex.plain: Quick hands, quick feet, a steady aim

int.plain: Book learning; powers a wizard's spells

wis.plain: Good sense and calm; powers a cleric's prayers

cha.plain: Charm and nerve; powers a bard's songs

terms.hp: Hit points (HP): how much harm you can take before you're knocked out of the fight.
terms.ac: Armour (AC): the number an attacker's dice roll has to reach to hit you. Higher is safer.
terms.prof: Training bonus: added to every attack you're trained for. It grows as your class levels up.
terms.mod: The small number next to each score is what it adds to your dice rolls.

classes.blurb: Stands at the front and takes the hits. Simple, sturdy and hard to knock down.
Strikes where it hurts. Deals extra damage when a friend is already fighting the same foe.
Fragile but fierce. Hurls fire from the back row and never misses with magic missiles.
Heals the party and burns away curses. The friend everyone wants on a hard adventure.
A patient shot from the back row. Marks one foe and keeps hitting it harder.
Fights with wit and music: lifts friends' rolls, mocks foes off their game, patches up wounds.

power_strike.desc: A huge swing: a little harder to land, a lot more damage.

second_wind.desc: Catch your breath and heal yourself. Once per battle.

guard.desc: Step in front of a friend: the next attack on them hits you instead, and your armour gets +2.

sneak_attack.desc: If a friend has already hit your target, or you are hidden, add 2d6 damage.

hide.desc: Slip into the shadows: your next attack rolls two dice and keeps the better one.

weak_spot.desc: Point out a gap in a foe's guard: everyone's attacks on it get +2 for two rounds.

magic_missile.desc: Three darts of light that always hit. Twice per battle.

frost_ray.desc: A beam of cold that slows the target: it acts last next round.

dispel.desc: Unravels a foe's ward at once so the party's blows land in full again.

healing_word.desc: A word of comfort that heals a friend at any distance. Three times per battle.

sacred_flame.desc: Holy light falls on a foe. It must dodge (a Dexterity save) or take the damage. Ignores armour.

bless.desc: The whole party adds 1d4 to their attacks for three rounds. Once per battle.

hunters_mark.desc: Mark a foe: your hits on it deal 1d6 more until it falls.

volley.desc: Rain arrows on every foe at once. Once per battle.

track.desc: Spot every foe's next move: the party's next attacks roll two dice and keep the better. Once per battle.

vicious_mockery.desc: A cutting insult. The foe must keep its nerve (a Wisdom save) or take damage and roll badly on its next attack.

inspire.desc: A rousing tune: a friend's next roll uses two dice and keeps the better.

soothing_song.desc: Heals the whole party a little. Once per battle.
